regressions.retirementTimingScope: Wall time from retirePrinter call through fixture dependency release and retained-service queries. Stop callbacks are simulated; not physical timing.

result.scope: Desktop synchronous two-object response construction with fresh request lifetimes. No Python, target-board or physical print comparison; high-frequency cost also requires a compiled concurrent-print regression.

requestScope.interpretation: Added median batch-average query construction cost about 1.180 microseconds. Finite single-process ABBA microbenchmark, not per-request P99 or strict no-regression proof.

result.scope: Synchronous metadata response construction and bounded validation of a two-MCU snapshot. Third variant also constructs printer.info identity and protocol state; identity captured once. Excludes HTTP/RPC serialization, device getters and physical printing.

compiled.interpretation: Fresh independent compiled package with no Python or TS loading in child; existing upload/print/pause/reinitialize/fault/process-restart regression passed. Retained-listener retirement method is directly covered by source product-service tests, not a new compiled restart-button journey.
